work.title: Shallow-clone push gate names the requirement but not the remedy
work.evidence: _check_history_integrity now prints .git/shallow pin SHA and 'git fetch --unshallow origin'. Two new tests assert the remedy string and pin SHA are present. Workflow depth-1 steps annotated CI-only.

work.title: Push-files warning fires on valid explicit-refspec push
work.evidence: warn_if_push_files_incomplete adds quiet path 2: single-ref push where local SHA is HEAD and local_ref != remote_ref. Two new tests cover quiet and warning paths. Mutation harness verifies each load-bearing line.

work.title: Global push lock serializes the fleet
work.evidence: GOTCHAS.md now gives per-branch flock recipe. Retrospective entry corrected. No repo tooling references the global lock; it is an operator convention. The per-branch recipe is the correct replacement.

work.title: Repair pushes miss PR bypass policy when local and remote branch names differ
work.evidence: resolve_push_update derives destination_branch from push_ref.remote_ref (line 3136 in git_hook_policy.py). _check_commit_limit uses destination_branch for PR lookup. Verified with a manual trace: PushRef(local='fix/repair', remote='perf/batch') yields destination_branch='perf/batch'. Closing with evidence.
